behaviour: A dev push runs its Sonar analysis in sonar-after-unit, which needs unit and so asks for a runner only after every unit leg, numbered or the single copy leg, has finished; its coverage wait then takes all twenty legs on its first poll and the merge combines each of them. The sonar job keeps its condition and needs, hands a dev push off in seconds without a checkout or an evidence upload, and still starts beside the unit shards on a pull request. On a push the analysis carries the check name sonar and the hand off the name sonar hand off, and promotion ready and promote read the analysis from sonar-after-unit.
seam: The Tests workflow sonar and sonar-after-unit jobs with the shared sonar step list, the source decision step under SONAR_HAND_OFF, promotion ready and promote, .github/coverage/arrivals.arrive over a full first listing, and .github/coverage/combine.sh over the legs scripts.ci_unit_copy layout and upload leave
